compounds.working_name: Veto reserve reproduction trap

component_ideas.proposition: If a resident may veto a care robot task only after arranging substitute labor, then formal veto availability can fall as other residents stop maintaining substitute routines.

If separately approved commitments reserve the same refusal-compatible substitutes, then their combination can cross a threshold at which no jointly feasible refusal path remains, even while every grant stays fixed and review utilization stays low; veto effectiveness should track residual substitute feasibility rather than approval count.

If institutions fund dispute staff from recent complaint volume, improved agent reliability can reduce independent review capacity enough that rare future failures receive worse remedies than under a less reliable system with a maintained dispute workforce.

compounds.strongest_version: Valid commitments consume common substitutes while reliable routine service reduces complaint-funded review practice. If exercising a veto requires both a substitute and competent interpretation, falling use of vetoes can make those two resources look unnecessary and justify further reductions.

signed_edges.mechanism: Each commitment reserves the same fallback labor.
Reviewers can identify and execute legitimate refusal paths.
Available routes can actually be exercised.
A use-based budget supports the resources.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Low feasible vetoes lower observed use, which lowers resource funding and makes later vetoes still less feasible; commitment-driven reserve consumption initiates the loop.

compounds.emergent_property: Self-maintaining nominal veto rights with neither jointly available labor nor independent interpretive capacity.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: The components separately describe labor-conditioned veto, shared reservation feasibility and reliability-linked review budgets; none links low exercised veto demand back to reproduction of both enabling resources.
compounds.surprising_prediction: At equal permissions and comprehension at deployment, lowering routine failures can accelerate later veto infeasibility when funding responds to observed veto use.

measurable_state_variable.name: joint veto reserve
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Number of simultaneous legitimate vetoes executable with both spare labor and competent independent reviewers.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: A bottleneck regime begins when either spare substitute capacity or reviewer capacity falls below joint veto demand; use-linked replenishment permits persistence after demand falls.
assumptions: Funding responds to exercised rather than latent demand.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: With those rules fixed, declining exercised vetoes does not reduce enabling resources or future feasible vetoes.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same use-responsive funding loop can build robust refusal capacity where exercised legitimate vetoes reveal latent need and induce investment rather than decay.
compounds.neutral_control: Both resources are funded independently of current veto use.

survival_rules_met.support: Joint veto reserve separates nominal rights from joint execution.
Two complementary capacity bottlenecks bound feasible vetoes.
Fund latent capacity rather than merely add approval prompts.

compounds.uncertainty: Funding responsiveness and which resource binds are unmeasured; low veto use can also reflect genuine satisfaction, not control loss.

cross_edge_ablation.removed_cross_edge_or_component: Observed veto use → reserve and review funding
cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Hold protected fallback and reviewer funding fixed while routine veto use falls.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Reliability improvements no longer reduce later veto feasibility through the claimed funding channel; independent reserve overbooking may remain.

compounds.working_name: Correction creates an evidence arrears queue

component_ideas.proposition: If a person can correct a profile at its origin but downstream institutions retain decisions derived from the earlier profile, then the correction right fails to restore opportunities unless derivations are revisited.
If public agents initially reject circumstances outside an executable category scheme, then broadening that scheme later cannot repair claims whose evidence or filing opportunity has expired.

If challenge rights require reading complete ancestry records before filing and the records grow with automation volume, formally increased transparency can reduce the fraction of low-resource challengers who reach a substantive hearing before a deadline.

compounds.strongest_version: An accepted origin correction triggers reopening across downstream decisions, but each reopened case demands a longer complete ancestry before admission. New corrections can expand the required reconstruction backlog faster than claimants can enter it, causing expiry of precisely the claims correction was meant to repair.

signed_edges.mechanism: One corrected profile supports several prior decisions.
Each decision requires its derivation chain.
Later decisions build on still-unresolved derivations.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Unrepaired derivations continue to generate later ancestry, raising reconstruction burdens and delaying admission of their corrections.

compounds.emergent_property: Successful correction at the origin generates a growing arrears stock rather than effective network correction.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Reopening duties, irreversible filing loss and ancestry admission burdens are individually stated; their recursive effect on the ancestry of later decisions is not.
compounds.surprising_prediction: A more responsive origin-correction service can increase unresolved downstream disputes if reopening fans out while admission remains ancestry-gated.

measurable_state_variable.name: correction arrears
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Consequential derived decisions awaiting repair, weighted by the reconstruction work needed before their claims can be admitted.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: Arrears grow when correction-induced reopening work plus new derived work exceeds admissible reconstruction throughput; restoring throughput later does not restore expired opportunities.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Reopening fan-out does not increase pending reconstruction or expired claims under the specified admission rule.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same derivation-triggered reopening loop propagates useful corrections quickly when concise admission and sufficient reconstruction capacity keep repairs ahead of new derivations.
compounds.neutral_control: Corrected profiles have no consequential downstream derivations.

survival_rules_met.support: Work-weighted correction arrears is observable.
Reopening work can cross reconstruction capacity.
Origin correction success and network repair cease to be equivalent.

compounds.uncertainty: The assumed reopening rule and recursion may not hold in real institutions; no prevalence or bad-faith conclusion follows.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Bound reopened claims to their corrected source and exclude unresolved descendants from subsequent admission prerequisites.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Faster origin correction cannot amplify future ancestry work through unresolved descendants; the initial reopening burst remains.

compounds.working_name: Privacy victory through collateral substitution

component_ideas.proposition: If recipients can delete intimate care logs but those logs are the only evidence for contesting a harmful staffing decision, then privacy exercise and procedural redress can become mutually obstructive.

If a regulator must reconstruct an agent incident after local logs were minimized and cannot target a narrow evidence path, stronger routine minimization can increase total privacy exposure by forcing broad requests for third-party communications.

If proof that an agent may negotiate requires displaying earlier relationship transactions, a current principal can gain counterpart recognition by revealing identities and terms of previous counterparties who never consented to this new evidentiary use.

compounds.strongest_version: Deleting a principal's intimate care evidence can force both appeals and new authority proofs to seek prior counterpart records. If each collateral request then creates its own evidentiary basis for future proofs, deletion can move a growing documentary burden into the non-user network rather than remove it.

signed_edges.mechanism: The appeal loses its original record.
Investigators and mandate recognizers seek substitutes.
Later gaps require confirmation of these records.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Collateral records become the recognized substitute history and create future confirmation demand on the same absent parties.

compounds.emergent_property: A privacy-minimized account coupled to an expanding external proof bureaucracy.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Deletion/redress conflict, wider investigation and prior-counterparty proof exposure do not individually specify the substitution records becoming the next generation of mandate evidence.
compounds.surprising_prediction: Repeated account minimization can increase non-user documentary workload even while the account's retained bytes decline monotonically.

measurable_state_variable.name: external evidence dependence
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Share of appeal and mandate validity supported by non-user records and repeated confirmations.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: Substitution grows where collateral proof reuse outpaces expiry; it saturates or reverses when independently sufficient minimal receipts break further requests.
assumptions: Collateral responses are retained and reused.
Deletion does not cancel the underlying dispute or mandate.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Collateral responses neither persist into later proofs nor generate additional confirmation demand.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same evidence-substitution network can restore a silenced person's claims where willing counterparties hold accurate corroboration and reuse reduces repeated storytelling.
compounds.neutral_control: Deletion leaves a sufficient nonidentifying dispute and mandate receipt.

survival_rules_met.support: External evidence dependence differs from account retention.
Preserve sufficient receipts rather than maximize or minimize raw logs indiscriminately.
Local privacy improvement can coexist with greater network disclosure.

compounds.uncertainty: Reuse may be prohibited; collateral exposure can be benign or wanted. Total welfare requires affected-party assessment.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Make collateral evidence single-use and prohibit treating it as the default history for later mandate recognition.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Principal deletion can still trigger one investigation, but repeated confirmation duties do not propagate onto the same non-users.

compounds.working_name: Rehearsal-priced renewal lock

component_ideas.proposition: If a service institution observes users rehearsing substitute arrangements, then it may offer better terms before exit while users who cannot rehearse appear less contestable despite equal service satisfaction.

If a provider controls fallback drills and supplies recoverable cases drawn from its own decision traces, it can report strong human takeover performance while failing to train distinctions needed when the provider and its traces disappear together.

If a program pays professionals for fallback drill completion but does not measure which judgments were exercised, the cheapest bids can come from professionals using agents to complete the drills, increasing certified reserve counts without producing more independent capacity.

compounds.strongest_version: Visible exit rehearsal wins better renewal terms, while completion subsidies favor provider-trace-dependent drills. Users can therefore gain bargaining rewards from rehearsals that do not build independent recovery; improved renewal terms may reduce actual exits, leaving the hidden training dependency untested.

signed_edges.mechanism: Providers treat completed drills as contestability evidence.
Scaffolded drills are easier to complete.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Cheap completions induce concessions, fewer actual exits and less independent validation, preserving the cheap curriculum.

compounds.emergent_property: High apparent contestability and good renewal prices with low tested recovery autonomy.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Bargaining effects of rehearsal, trace dependency and subsidy selection do not individually describe concessions suppressing the transfers that would test the rehearsal signal.
compounds.surprising_prediction: Better retention offers can improve user prices while slowing discovery that exit certificates depend on incumbent traces.

measurable_state_variable.name: unvalidated contestability
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Completed exit certificates not independently validated through trace-free novel transfer.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: A stable apparent-contestability regime is possible if concession-induced retention suppresses validation faster than independent drills invalidate certificates.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Concessions do not reduce independent validation or trace-based drills predict genuine trace-free exit equally well.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same rehearsal-concession-validation loop can sustain useful competition without repeated disruptive switching when rehearsals genuinely certify independent substitutes.
compounds.neutral_control: Rehearsal validation is independent of actual exit frequency.

survival_rules_met.support: Unvalidated contestability distinguishes prices from autonomy.
Require independent drill validation rather than forcing unnecessary exits.
A cheap renewal offer and a usable outside option need not coincide.

compounds.uncertainty: The behavioral retention response is assumed; concessions need not be manipulative and can be valuable.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Provide the same concession but randomly require independently supported transfer trials regardless of renewal.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Better renewal prices no longer suppress the observations that reveal incumbent-scaffolded certificates.

compounds.working_name: The stop-settlement wave

component_ideas.proposition: If posthumous agents create pending exchanges under a valid mandate, then revoking that mandate stops new action but can leave living counterparties bound to reservations or expectations created earlier.

If an agent can stop issuing commitments immediately but its existing commitments mature over long and uneven intervals, evaluating revocation only by new-action cessation will understate residual exposure; two agents with identical stopping latency can produce different recovery cash and coordination needs because their obligation maturity distributions differ.

If providers sell recovery guarantees against the same small pool of substitute infrastructure without disclosing overlap, the market price of insured recovery can fall while the quantity of simultaneously deliverable restoration remains fixed.

compounds.strongest_version: Simultaneous legitimate revocation stops new agent commitments quickly but releases many matured or pending obligations into the same restoration pool. Fast coordinated stopping can create a settlement demand wave whose delays leave counterparties treating old representation as practically active.

signed_edges.mechanism: More reconciliation is needed before release.
Additional reliance disputes reenter the same disposition pool.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Delayed release sustains old reliance that generates additional reconciliation work, lengthening the settlement queue.

compounds.emergent_property: A formally stopped agent ecology with persistent practical representation and residual obligations.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Revocation residuals, maturity distributions and shared restoration claims do not separately specify queue delay sustaining the very reliance that adds settlement work.
compounds.surprising_prediction: Reducing local stopping latency can worsen short-horizon coordinated release if it synchronizes settlement arrivals without increasing restoration capacity.

measurable_state_variable.name: released-but-unsettled mandate stock
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Stopped mandates whose commitments or counterpart recognition still require disposition.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: A settlement-wave threshold occurs when maturity-weighted release work exceeds shared restoration service over the required release horizon.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Release delays do not sustain counterparty reliance or extra settlement work under clustered stops.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same preserved reliance and shared settlement queue protects legitimate dependents from abrupt abandonment when obligations can be processed within their continuity horizon.
compounds.neutral_control: No pending obligations or counterparty reservations remain at revocation.

survival_rules_met.support: Unsettled mandate stock distinguishes cessation from release.
Shared restoration capacity bounds coordinated settlement.
Persistent practical representation is not created by a new microgrant.

compounds.uncertainty: Reservation behavior and obligation durations are unknown; persistence may be legally required and beneficial rather than illegitimate.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Preserve the stopping wave but resolve all later counterparty reliance under a separately funded bounded queue.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: A local latency reduction may create an initial burst but cannot prolong the primary release queue by generating new reconciliation work.

compounds.working_name: Successor veto without a recognized voice

component_ideas.proposition: If an organization continues accepting a deceased member agent as the most informed representative of that member interests, then living successors may bear proof burdens to exercise rights already transferred to them.

If every affected household has a consultation right but the implementation recognizes only organizations as veto issuers, then a dispersed community can lack effective control despite unanimous private opposition.
If different institutions recognize an inherited agent as continuous for different purposes, then successors may claim continuity where it preserves assets and discontinuity where it avoids burdens.

compounds.strongest_version: A successor can own an inherited agent while institutions continue recognizing its historical representative. If a collective successor group lacks a permitted issuer type, it may be unable to contest continuity claims, encouraging actors to choose institutional forums that recognize the most favorable continuity.

signed_edges.mechanism: Institutions defer to the informed delegate.
Dispersed successors cannot issue a recognized claim.
Successful challenge limits inconsistent continuity claims.
Actors invoke continuity where it preserves benefits.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Recognized legacy representation raises successor burdens that weaken challenges and preserve selective recognition.

compounds.emergent_property: Ownership transfer without a collectively usable channel to redirect inherited representation.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Informational succession, collective issuer mismatch and strategic purpose-specific continuity do not individually describe their mutually reinforcing standing lock.
compounds.surprising_prediction: Adding formally equal successor ownership shares can reduce group control if none maps to a recognized collective objection type.

measurable_state_variable.name: successor voice deficit
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Legitimate successor interests lacking a recognized route to alter purpose-specific representation.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: A standing lock is possible when proof costs rise with successor fragmentation and legacy recognition supplies the default in unresolved disputes.
assumptions: Group standing differs from individual ownership.
Legacy recognition persists while disputes are unresolved.
Actors can choose among institutional purposes.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Fragmentation does not affect recognized objection or selective continuity under fixed ownership.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same continuity default protects vulnerable beneficiaries against opportunistic successors when the legacy delegate faithfully documents obligations and collective representation is accessible.
compounds.neutral_control: Authority transfer automatically transfers recognized representation to an accountable successor body.

survival_rules_met.support: Successor voice deficit is distinct from ownership.
Repair issuer standing rather than merely transfer software.
Legacy practical voice persists without newly granted control.

compounds.uncertainty: Succession rules vary; this is not a statement of current law or evidence that any delegate acts strategically.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Require one common successor-recognition rule for both assets and objections.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Adding equal successor shares can still impose coordination cost but cannot preserve the legacy delegate by selectively denying the group's objection standing.

compounds.working_name: Restoration loses its teachers

component_ideas.proposition: If residents can stop a robot deployment after buildings remove human-accessible routes, then stopping operation alone can leave non-users less mobile than before deployment.

If agents replace junior cases before an expert cohort retires, then reinstating those cases afterward can require longer recovery because the mentors who made practice educational are no longer available.
If robot-oriented redesign dissolves informal human escort routines, then restoring the physical route can leave vulnerable occupants less able to use it despite identical geometry.

compounds.strongest_version: Physical robot-oriented redesign can dissolve human escort routines while automation removes novice cases and mentors retire. A later community decision to restore routes may recreate the geometry but not the social teaching process that made the routes usable.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Low restored usability limits route use and the encounters needed to reproduce escort capacity, sustaining loss after geometry returns.

compounds.emergent_property: Geometrically restored access trapped below its former social usability.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Post-stop route damage, mentor retirement and escort-network loss do not individually connect restoration failure to missing reproduction of the escort network.
compounds.surprising_prediction: Restoring the same route and the same nominal assistance hours can fail if mentor succession was interrupted during automation.

measurable_state_variable.name: socially usable restored capacity
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Route capacity executable by the current helper network, not geometry alone.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: Recovery may require an external teaching pulse if use below a participation threshold produces too few mentoring encounters to replace retiring helpers.
assumptions: Escort knowledge is taught through encounters.
Some residents need more than geometry.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Reinstated geometry immediately restores prior usability independently of mentor and escort availability.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same use-to-teaching-to-usability loop can let a small initial restoration investment rebuild a durable human-access network faster than perpetual individual support.
compounds.neutral_control: All required knowledge is transferable without mentors and residents need no social assistance.

survival_rules_met.support: Socially usable capacity separates built space from actual access.
Teaching encounters may have a replacement threshold.
Restore mentoring networks alongside geometry.

compounds.uncertainty: Mentoring thresholds and social needs are assumed; no argument requires withholding beneficial mobility robots.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: After restoration, supply structured apprentice escort encounters independently of route uptake.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Restored geometry need not remain unusable because low uptake fails to reproduce helper knowledge; unrelated physical barriers can still matter.

compounds.working_name: Review windows consume each other's validity

component_ideas.proposition: If each institution provides a sufficient local review period but its disclosed conditions expire asynchronously, then a shared action can lack any interval in which all conditions are simultaneously valid and reviewable; extending the final deadline alone will not restore effective joint review.

If institutions promise agent-supported projects guaranteed future human review without accounting for overlapping review commitments, selling more projects can create claims on the same attention slots and turn overdue review into pressure to approve bundled outcomes.

If personal agents faithfully reactivate old commitments from several life roles, then individually valid reminders can jointly demand more attention than the person can supply without any single request being excessive.

compounds.strongest_version: Institutions promise a person's future review time while their disclosed conditions expire asynchronously. Authentic reminders of all obligations can consume the intervals in which joint terms are simultaneously reviewable, so adding more local review time need not create a usable joint window.

signed_edges.mechanism: Projects claim the same future attention.
Overlapping terms have fewer available intervals.
A common valid interval enables completion.
Settled work need not be redone.
New requests reserve future attention again.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Failed joint review creates repeated claims on future time, further reducing common validity windows.

compounds.emergent_property: Every institution offers adequate local review while the person lacks any feasible joint review schedule.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Validity overlap, advance attention claims and faithful cross-role reminders do not individually specify failed review regenerating more scheduled demands.
compounds.surprising_prediction: Longer local windows can leave joint review worse if they induce additional advance claims without aligning condition validity.

measurable_state_variable.name: joint-validity attention slack
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Unclaimed attention intervals contained in the intersection of all required condition-validity windows.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: The joint feasible set disappears when calendar claims cover every common-validity interval; extending a final deadline alone does not reopen it.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: A common unclaimed valid interval remains available yet joint completion declines for the proposed reason.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same reminder-and-reservation loop coordinates useful joint review when claims protect aligned valid windows and prevent routine work from consuming them.
compounds.neutral_control: Condition snapshots are frozen and advance claims cannot overlap.

survival_rules_met.support: Joint-validity attention slack is measurable.
Feasible review disappears at interval-covering threshold.
Adequate local windows differ from a usable joint window.

compounds.uncertainty: The regeneration rule must be established; inability to review may reflect ordinary workload rather than agent-specific emergence.

cross_edge_ablation.removed_cross_edge_or_component: Repeated reauthorization requests → advance review claims
cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Preserve validity intervals but cap failed-review rebookings within a common reserved window.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Failed review cannot recursively occupy the windows needed for its own repair; originally disjoint validity intervals can still block review.

compounds.working_name: Minimal continuity becomes the new evidence ceiling

component_ideas.proposition: If an exit package contains executable tests of essential routines rather than a complete personal history, a replacement service can preserve critical continuity with less intimate data exposure when those routines depend on verifiable constraints rather than autobiographical interpretation.

If replacement agents learn institutional practice only from completed actions, they can miss rules expressed through repeated abstention because prohibited or inappropriate actions leave no success record; two equally complete transaction histories can support different safe replacements when only one preserves reasons for not acting.

If professional agents make a superior diagnostic or advisory process routinely available, then institutions may treat using it as required diligence, shifting liability and access burdens onto professionals or clients unable to obtain it.

compounds.strongest_version: A minimal executable transfer package can become the accepted diligence standard because it performs well on visible routines. If it omits abstention reasons, institutions may stop preserving them; later replacements then lack evidence of unusual constraints and their failures reinforce demands for the same standardized package rather than broader rationale.

signed_edges.mechanism: Institutions treat the successful format as sufficient diligence.
Institutions respond using their recognized assurance format.
Enforcement supports the recognized format and its retention budget.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: A failure response focused on the existing standard strengthens the retention boundary that caused unusual constraints to disappear.

compounds.emergent_property: High standard conformance and routine continuity with shrinking institution-specific negative constraint memory.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Minimal packages, absent-action knowledge and diligence institutionalization do not individually specify a format becoming the ceiling on what future institutions remember.
compounds.surprising_prediction: Increasing compliance with a successful portability standard can worsen rare boundary transfers if the standard excludes valid non-event rationales.

measurable_state_variable.name: standard-excluded constraint stock
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Current legitimate constraints known only through reasons outside the required transfer package.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: A format lock is possible when conformance drives archive budgets and failures are interpreted as noncompliance rather than missing standard dimensions.
assumptions: Relevant abstention reasons are not inferable from package tests.
Failure review defaults to the existing format.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Standard adoption preserves excluded rationales or boundary failures do not depend on their loss.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same standardization loop preserves essential constraints cheaply and frees privacy-sensitive biography from transfer when the package includes every materially relevant rationale.
compounds.neutral_control: The package covers all legitimate constraints, including sufficient abstention reasons.

survival_rules_met.support: Standard-excluded constraint stock can be audited.
Add rationale coverage rather than simply enforce existing conformance.
Routine package success differs from institutional constraint continuity.

compounds.uncertainty: Negative knowledge and organizational memory are inherited; no novelty conclusion is made. The feedback depends on how standards influence retention.

cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Fund equally retrievable, authenticated abstention rationales outside the minimum package while preserving its certification rules.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Rising standard compliance cannot worsen unusual boundary transfers by erasing excluded rationales; the minimum package alone may still be incomplete.

compounds.working_name: Uncertain standing and irreversible human evidence

component_ideas.proposition: If possible artificial welfare constrains memory alteration before evidence thresholds are settled, then a human may hold a formal right to revise personal context but be unable to exercise it without exposing more intimate evidence.

If uncertain machine standing is handled through reversible suspension and bounded preservation rather than immediate deletion or permanent operation, institutions can gather discriminating evidence while reducing both human service disruption and the cost of a later status revision.

If care automation removes human observation during a disputed period, then later restoration of staffing can improve future care but cannot reconstruct the testimony needed to settle harms from that period.

compounds.strongest_version: Preserving an old agent for uncertain-status assessment can delay human memory revision while replacement service reduces the need for human witnesses. If review is later resolved, both revision opportunities and the missing human testimony may be impossible to recreate, even though reversible machine-state suspension succeeded.

signed_edges.mechanism: Human context changes wait for assessment.
Routine needs are handled without people present.
Evidence supports correction without extra intimate disclosure.
Separate evidence can resolve practical conflicts faster.
Longer unresolved assessment requires continued replacement routines.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Delayed revision coincides with witness loss, weakening the independent evidence that could resolve the delay and extending it.

compounds.emergent_property: Reversible machine preservation paired with irreversible human evidentiary loss.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Status-related revision conflict, reversible suspension and irrecoverable witness opportunities do not individually specify their opposing reversibility properties reinforcing delay.
compounds.surprising_prediction: A lifecycle plan with better machine-state recoverability can leave the human less able to revise or contest their history if it displaces witness production during assessment.

measurable_state_variable.name: dual-continuity reversibility gap
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Difference between recoverable machine evidence and expired or unrecorded human revision evidence.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: The gap opens when assessment duration exceeds human evidentiary opportunity windows; suspension need not be harmful for the gap to exist.
assumptions: Some testimony cannot be reconstructed later.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Human evidence and revision opportunities remain equivalent across preservation plans with matched service continuity.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same preservation-plus-service arrangement protects human routines and future assessment when independent witnesses continue and relevant human opportunities remain open.
compounds.neutral_control: Human revision and appeal evidence are independently preserved during assessment.

survival_rules_met.support: Dual reversibility gap distinguishes two evidence subjects.
Preserve human evidence channels alongside machine state.
Reversible lifecycle storage differs from reversible human governance.

compounds.uncertainty: No patienthood or welfare neutrality is assumed; the human evidence pathway and assessment duration need empirical specification.

cross_edge_ablation.removed_cross_edge_or_component: Replacement service continuity → human witness encounters
cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Preserve reversible machine suspension while independently maintaining ordinary witness-producing human encounters.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Longer status assessment no longer weakens human revision evidence through replacement-induced witness loss; other review delays remain.

compounds.working_name: Certifier migration turns competition into a cut

component_ideas.proposition: If institutions accept agent transfers only after a recognized migration certificate, then tested portability can improve trust while certificate issuance becomes a new gate on access to substitutes.

If new agent providers introduce mutually incompatible obligation attestations and counterparties cannot afford all adapters, provider entry can reduce the fraction of relationships preserved after switching even as the number of nominal substitutes grows.

If a user’s counterparties accept credentials through a small set of mutually recognizing issuers, removing one issuer can disconnect most replacement-agent routes even when every profile is exportable and several replacement providers exist; replacement success should track recognition-path connectivity rather than provider count.

compounds.strongest_version: Provider entry creates more attestation formats while migration certification becomes the trusted acceptance gate. With fixed counterparty adapter budgets, institutions may centralize compatibility through one certifier, turning many competing providers into a market dependent on a single recognition cut.

signed_edges.mechanism: A common certificate reduces local work.
Alternatives permit replacement without that certifier.

causal_loop.closed_return_path: Adapter scarcity encourages a common gate whose growing use weakens alternatives and deepens dependence on the gate.

compounds.emergent_property: Competitive provider supply with concentrated practical recognition power.
compounds.why_absent_in_components: Certificate institutions, fragmentation and recognition cuts do not individually specify provider competition financing the emergence of a single certifier cut.
compounds.surprising_prediction: At fixed adapter capacity, more provider entry can increase certifier concentration even as provider concentration falls.

measurable_state_variable.name: recognition concentration gap
measurable_state_variable.operational_definition: Difference between provider diversity and the diversity of independently accepted migration proofs.

threshold_equilibrium_hysteresis.conditional_regime: A gate regime can form when direct adaptation costs exceed common-certification costs and proof alternatives decay through nonuse.

compounds.minimal_falsifier: Provider-format entry leaves alternative recognition paths and certifier dependence unchanged.
compounds.beneficial_mirror: The same central certification feedback can make previously incompatible providers usable and expand choice when alternative accountable proof paths remain available.
compounds.neutral_control: Direct recognition is cheap and alternatives are maintained independently of current use.

survival_rules_met.support: Recognition concentration gap is observable.
Support proof-path plurality rather than count providers only.
The certifier gains practical gate power without wider provider microgrants.

compounds.uncertainty: Certification can be legitimate and useful; actual budget substitution and proof-route decay are unmeasured.

cross_edge_ablation.removed_cross_edge_or_component: Central certifier reliance → independent recognition paths
cross_edge_ablation.controlled_intervention: Fund diverse independent attestation adapters at fixed coverage even when central certification is widely used.
cross_edge_ablation.prediction_lost: Additional provider formats may raise interpretation work but need not increase indispensability of one certifier as alternatives decay.

compounds.working_name: Contestability purchases its own measurement

component_ideas.proposition: If a service institution observes users rehearsing substitute arrangements, then it may offer better terms before exit while users who cannot rehearse appear less contestable despite equal service satisfaction.

If providers can sell improved interventions using privately estimated response curves but users cannot buy comparable estimates of their own exposure sensitivity, market competition can improve targeting faster than it improves users’ ability to compare the resulting relationships.
